econometric_drivers.title: Puget Sound Refining Complex & Trans Mountain Feedstock Decoupling
econometric_drivers.description: The Pacific Northwest operates as an autonomous refining center independent of California. Regional refineries (bp Cherry Point, Phillips 66 Ferndale, Marathon Anacortes, HF Sinclair Puget Sound) process Canadian crude via the Trans Mountain Pipeline system and Alaska North Slope (ANS) crude delivered via marine tankers, completely decoupled from California CARBOB formulations.

refining_logistics.title: Olympic Pipeline System & Puget Sound Marine Terminals
refining_logistics.description: Refined product distribution is anchored by the 400-mile Olympic Pipeline originating in Ferndale and Anacortes, traversing Seattle and Tacoma, and terminating in Portland, OR. Secondary regional distribution relies on marine barges throughout Puget Sound and the Columbia River.
refining_logistics.primary_refinery: bp Cherry Point Refinery (242 kbpd) & Phillips 66 Ferndale (105 kbpd)
pipelines: Trans Mountain Pipeline Puget Sound Spur

tax_structure.title: Washington State Motor Fuel Tax & Climate Commitment Act (CCA)
tax_structure.description: Washington levies a statutory motor fuel excise tax of $0.494/gal plus the Climate Commitment Act (CCA) cap-and-invest carbon allowance compliance costs. Combined with Federal excise ($0.184/gal), the statutory baseline burden is $0.678/gal (excluding carbon allowances).
tax_structure.notes: Statutory baseline excise tax of $0.678/gal; Washington Climate Commitment Act (CCA) carbon allowance mechanism operates separately from California LCFS/Cap-and-Trade.

infrastructure_delivery.title: Olympic Pipeline Seattle Rack Spreads & Puget Sound Logistics
infrastructure_delivery.description: Seattle wholesale rack prices reflect Olympic Pipeline tariffs, Puget Sound refining crack spreads against ANS/WCS crude, and regional tank farm inventories at Renton and Harbor Island.
infrastructure_delivery.hub_name: Renton Olympic Pipeline Junction & Harbor Island Marine Terminals

shock_scenarios.name: bp Cherry Point Unplanned Hydrocracker Outage
shock_scenarios.subtitle: Major Puget Sound Refining Unit Flaring & Tripping
shock_scenarios.description: Unplanned outage at the 242 kbpd bp Cherry Point refinery restricts regional supply, spiking Olympic Pipeline rack premiums across Seattle and Portland.

shock_scenarios.name: Olympic Pipeline High-Pressure Integrity Lockdown
shock_scenarios.subtitle: Mainline Flow Suspension from Ferndale to Portland
shock_scenarios.description: Pipeline inspection anomaly shuts Olympic Pipeline mainline deliveries south of Snohomish, stranding Puget Sound production and forcing expensive truck and marine barge substitution.

shock_scenarios.name: Trans Mountain Pipeline Expansion Ingress Surge
shock_scenarios.subtitle: Western Canadian Crude Influx Softening Feedstock Costs
shock_scenarios.description: Expanded heavy Canadian crude throughput into Puget Sound refineries depresses regional input costs, narrowing regional wholesale crack margins.
